title: Conditional relative frequency
body: A relative frequency computed by restricting to a particular level, or category of interest: a cell frequency in a row divided by that row's total, or a cell frequency in a column divided by that column's total.
caution: The denominator is the row or column total for the restricted category, not the total for the entire table (that would be a joint relative frequency).
ced_evidence: 2.2.A.3 "A conditional relative frequency is a relative frequency computed by restricting to a particular level, or category of interest."

title: Sample space
body: The set of all possible nonoverlapping outcomes of a random process, whose probability is 1.
ced_evidence: 2.4.A.1 "The sample space of a random process is the set of all possible nonoverlapping outcomes. The probability of the sample space is 1."

title: Cumulative probability distribution
body: A distribution, represented as a table or function, that shows the probability of being less than or equal to each value of the discrete random variable.
ced_evidence: 2.8.A.5 "A cumulative probability distribution can be represented as a table or function and shows the probability of being less than or equal to each value of the discrete random variable."

title: Continuous random variable
body: A variable that can take on any value within a specified domain, where every interval within the domain has a probability associated with it.
ced_evidence: 2.11.A.1 "A continuous random variable is a variable that can take on any value within a specified domain."
